xml_snippets.Title: DankPyon_ShadowSect (FactionDef)
xml_snippets.Label: Cultists
xml_snippets.Description Originale: DO NOT DEACTIVATE, IF YOU WANT TO RAID MEDIEVAL OVERHAUL HIDEOUTS.
xml_snippets.XML:
DankPyon_ShadowSect DO NOT DEACTIVATE, IF YOU WANT TO RAID MEDIEVAL OVERHAUL HIDEOUTS. Deep within the shadows of the world, whispers persist of a malevolent force known only as the Cultists. Long thought extinguished from memory, they linger like a haunting specter, devoted to the worship of false deities and ensnared in the practice of grotesque sacrifices. Their clandestine rituals, cloaked in secrecy, echo with the screams of the damned and the scent of blood. Masters of disguise and manipulation, they weave a web of deception that veils their existence from the eyes of the world. Rumors abound of their insidious infiltration into every stratum of society, their tendrils coiling around the unsuspecting like serpents awaiting the moment to strike. Feeding on the flesh of the fallen, they are cannibals driven by primal hunger and twisted devotion. Yet amidst the horror, legends speak of hidden sanctuaries strewn with ancient relics and cursed treasures, concealed within their unholy enclaves. Beware the shadows, for within them lies the domain of the Cultists, a realm where darkness reigns eternal and the boundaries between nightmare and reality blur into oblivion.

xml_snippets.XML:
DankPyon_NobleHouseCivil2 War is a profitable endeavor, much so, that trading and haggling is as relentlessly ferocious as winning a battle. House Soren is notoriously recognized to be the masters of the trade, cunningly closing each profitable bargain. Many of their acquisitions are gained by honest trading but also through deceit, bribery, and extortion. Their towns are filled with riches as the house resides in their decadent castles, whilst pot-bellied peasants litter the streets. House Soren's influence stretches far and wide, with their merchant fleets dominating the seas and their caravans threading through the most dangerous routes. They possess a network of spies and informants, ensuring they are always a step ahead of their rivals. The halls of their castles are adorned with treasures from distant lands, a testament to their vast wealth and far-reaching connections. Once subjugated under the oppressive rule of the shattered empire, House Soren was among the first to seize the opportunity for independence when the empire's grip weakened. Their struggle for control over the other houses has been fierce, leveraging their economic prowess to tip the scales in their favor. They have successfully established themselves as a dominant force, exploiting the power vacuum left by the empire's collapse.

Now, one of the many noble houses, yet their ambitions to etch their name in history have yet to run dry. In an attempt to recover the treasure of the old under-empires, their expeditions uncover the earth in search of the depths of the ruins. Guided by ancient maps and whispered legends, House Oswin's explorers delve into forgotten catacombs and shadowed caverns. Each descent is fraught with peril, as they navigate labyrinthine passages and face guardians of stone and steel. Yet, undeterred by the trials, they press on, driven by the promise of untold riches and arcane knowledge hidden beneath the soil. Their legacy is written not in ink, but in the very bones of the earth they unearth.

xml_snippets.Title: TribeCannibal (FactionDef)
xml_snippets.Label: cannibal tribe
xml_snippets.Description Originale:
These people have been here a very long time. Maybe their ancestors crashed here a thousand years ago. Maybe they survived some cataclysm that destroyed a technological civilization here. In any case, the tribals are mostly nomadic people who live off the land using primitive tools and weapons.

Despite their apparent technological weakness, the tribals can be dangerous enemies because of their skill with low-tech warfare, their numbers, and their hardiness.

This particularly vicious tribe believes eating the flesh of their enemies is a great honor.

xml_snippets.Title: CannibalPirate (FactionDef)
xml_snippets.Label: cannibal pirate gang
xml_snippets.Description Originale:
A loose confederation of pirate groups who've agreed to mostly fight outsiders instead of fighting each other.

Pirates don't sow, they don't build, and they rarely trade. Driven by a blood-and-honor culture that values personal strength and ruthlessness, they enrich themselves by raiding and robbing their more productive neighbors.

Their technology level depends mostly on who they've managed to steal from recently. Mostly they carry gunpowder weapons, though some prefer to stab victims at close range.

This particular gang of pirates are cannibals.

xml_snippets.Title: Empire (FactionDef)
xml_snippets.Label: shattered empire
xml_snippets.Description Originale:
An ultratech refugee society from the planet Sophiamunda. Their culture is based on a code of honor, a strict class system, and enforced social stasis.

These are the survivors of a great calamity that tore apart Sophian society. They fled to the rimworld using the remnants of their fleet. Despite losing so much, their ships and technology still make them powerful.

They will refuse to trade with anyone who lacks the appropriate royal title.
